programs.title: Quest for the Lost Vikings
programs.desc: As planning for a northern expedition continues, the Farm Heim team starts testing the gear they will use in their bigger quest. Meanwhile, Jo, Johann, and David set out for Berens River, a place with potential clues of Lost Vikings.

programs.title: Mysteries of the Ancient Dead
programs.desc: Explorers uncover one of the largest Incan burial sites at Ancon on the Peruvian coast; it may be proof that the Chacoans were a matriarchal society.

programs.title: Revolutions That Changed History
programs.desc: A secret society of Russian military officers with dreams of political revolution set out to overthrow the Romanovs by spreading a lie about one Tsar usurping another.

programs.title: Alien Corridors
programs.desc: A look at what it is about this barren land that is attracting alien attention; is it the sensation of otherworldliness making it feel like home?

programs.title: Secrets in the Ice
programs.desc: In Russia, 34,000-year-old graves are discovered; a team attempts to locate a World War II British airplane that went missing in Iceland; tiny fossils in an Alaskan riverbank; a massive, previously undiscovered depression in the ice in Antarctica.

programs.title: Ancient Bodies: Secrets Revealed
programs.desc: The human remains of a woman are found near Vejle, Denmark; an archaeologist begins to tell a story about who she was and why she was murdered, connecting her to ancient fairy tales and even King Harald Bluetooth.
